definitions.explanation: The leading kabuki theatre in Japan, in the Ginza district of Tokyo, first opened in 1889 and rebuilt several times, most recently in 2013. Its name stands for kabuki at its most traditional and prestigious.

notes:
The suffix 〜⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧ marks a theatre or troupe, as in {歌舞伎座|かぶきざ} and other old playhouse names. {一幕見席|ひとまくみせき}, single-act tickets sold on the day, let visitors sample a performance without buying a full programme.
